main.title: Tokens are decisions, not values
main.lead: Why a design system should name its choices.

items.text: A token called blue-500 tells you what it is. A token called action tells you why it’s there, and that’s the part a team argues about.
When the brand moves, values change and decisions don’t. Name the decision, and a new value is one edit instead of a hunt.
Every token is a choice someone has to make again. Fewer, clearer choices make a system people actually use.
